# Research projects

Everything I have been doing this past few years!

### Stress, Health and Senescence in roe deer
:::
:::{.column-page-left}
::::: cover-container
<div class="cover-pic-wrapper">
![](../assets/images/glucocorticoids_black.png){.cover-pic-left .light-image}
![](../assets/images/glucocorticoids_white.png){.cover-pic-left .dark-image}</div>
::: cover-text-stress
<p style="text-align:right;">
<big>During my Ph.D, I have explored the relationships between chronic stress, as measured by glucocorticoid metabolites, and the senescence of health- and fitness-related traits in two populations of roe deer, followed longitudinally by capture-mark-recapture programs.<br><br></big>
</p>
<p style="text-align:center;">
[**Find out more**](../Projects/Stress.qmd){.button}
</p>
:::

### Asian elephants ageing
:::
:::{.column-page-left}
::::: cover-container
<div class="cover-pic-wrapper">
![](../assets/images/elephant_black.png){.cover-pic-left height="600px" .light-image}
![](../assets/images/elephant_white.png){.cover-pic-left height="600px" .dark-image}</div>
::: cover-text-eleph
<p style="text-align:right;">
<big>In 2020, during the pandemic, I exploited the unique database of the [Myanmar Timber Elephant Project](https://elephant-project.science/){.text-link}. I described sex-specific body mass senescence in adult Asian elephants (*Elephas maximus*). 
<br>I also reviewed the relationships between social environments and patterns of senescence in mammals.<br><br> </big>
</p>
<p style="text-align:center;">
[**Further details**](../Projects/Elephants.qmd){.button}
</p>
:::
